caption: The surface the interferometer recovers (`ifo_surface_recovery.png`): the fitted truth model (tilt plus sphere) and the residual after the fit, in nm.
number: With the test optic a flat (the injected sphere radius is effectively infinite), the phase-shifted interferometer recovers it to a post-fit residual of %pin:p2_bench_ifo_resid% nm rms surface, at a median fringe visibility of %pin:p2_bench_ifo_vis%; the two phase-recovery algorithms (de Groot 7-frame and Hariharan 5-frame) agree to the floor of the arithmetic, printed as a bound.
prompt: Using templates/40_benches/bench_ifo, make the test optic a 5 m radius sphere with 20 urad of tilt and rerun, and tell me the recovered radius and tilt errors and the post-fit residual.
